name: from_ptr
declaration: const unsafe fn from_ptr < 'a > (ptr : * mut * mut T) -> & 'a AtomicPtr < T >
rules: `ptr` must be aligned to `align_of::<AtomicPtr<T>>()`, which can be greater than `align_of::<*mut T>()` on some platforms.
`ptr` must be valid for both reads and writes for the entire lifetime `'a` of the returned `&'a AtomicPtr<T>`.

Accesses to the memory referenced by the returned `AtomicPtr<T>` must not cause data races: overlapping accesses where at least one is a write and at least one is non-atomic must be synchronized so that one happens-before the other. An unsuccessful `compare_exchange` or `compare_exchange_weak` is not considered a write.

Every pair of atomic accesses to the memory referenced by the returned `AtomicPtr<T>` for which neither happens-before the other must either be disjoint, access exactly the same memory with the same access size, or both be reads.
Concurrent atomic and non-atomic reads of the same memory referenced by the returned `AtomicPtr<T>` are permitted.
